labels.label: risk
labels.reason: SSL compression support is removed, so any deployment or client config that still requests sslcompression will lose that capability and may need config changes.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Server and libpq support for the version 2 wire protocol is removed, so very old clients or drivers using it will fail to connect.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Single-quoted language names in CREATE/DROP LANGUAGE are now disallowed, so existing scripts or migrations using that syntax will error.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Composite types formerly created for sequences and toast tables are removed, which could break code or queries that referenced those types.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: ecpg now processes doubled quote marks differently, a behavior change that could affect applications that worked around the old behavior and require recompilation or review.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: intarray containment operators no longer use GiST indexes, which changes query plans and the text says indexes created for this purpose should be removed.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The contrib program pg_standby is removed, so setups relying on it for warm standby will need migration to streaming replication or another approach.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: normal_rand() now rejects negative values, so callers passing negative values will start failing.
